title: Wire
body:
Wire

How to create a Wire

PC

Hover over a black square (input/output) on any Logic component and press E on your keyboard.

Hover over another black square (input/output) on any Logic component and press E on your keyboard again, now press Confirm at the bottom of your screen.

Mobile

Tap on a black square (input/output) on any Logic component and tap on Create Wire.

Tap on another black square (input/output) on any Logic component and tap on the black square, now press Confirm at the bottom of your screen.

Trivia

  • The largest number that can be transmitted through a wire is 999,999,999,999.
